answer: Each identity must post a commitment on the orchard board before the epoch opens: a hash of its work plus a 40-credit bond. Auditors match revealed work against the nebula ledger; a missed or mismatched reveal burns the bond and suspends the identity. Each hash binds one identity and one epoch, so the kth fake still posts a fresh hash and locks 40 credits, and 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 credits. One honest agent posts once, reveals once, and keeps its bond. A rented commitment fails violet verification: mismatched work is blocked from payout and both sides lose their bonds.
